name: frontier-loop
description: Responsibility-correct, direct-first Codex engineering with a conditional FOUNDATION/REDUCTION/REALITY judgment doctrine, 23 routed Skills, proportional verification, safe migrations, transactional installation, and approval-gated evolution—without automatic self-modification, a daemon, SQLite, or a second state owner.

interface.shortDescription: Responsibility-correct engineering with 23 routed Skills and verified delivery.
interface.longDescription: frontier-core owns every non-trivial change through Data, Responsibility, Module/Core, API, Verification, Observability, and Cleanup decisions; structural work conditionally applies FOUNDATION, REDUCTION, REALITY, and a mechanism-admission contract without adding another Skill or router. Seven Skills are implicit and sixteen explicit. FrontierLoop adds bounded architecture recovery, deterministic evaluation and release, and transactional install/rollback, while never automatically modifying itself, replacing global AGENTS.md, or adding a daemon, SQLite, or a second state owner.
defaultPrompt: Implement this clear change directly and escalate only concrete uncertainty.
Replace this unbounded polling, scanning, cache, or background mechanism with the smallest verified authoritative path.
Plan this persisted-format migration with compatibility, recovery, and a separate destructive cutover.
Draft an evidence-backed FrontierLoop improvement proposal without modifying the active plugin.
Compare a preserved FrontierLoop baseline and candidate with deterministic and repeated live evidence before promotion.
